comparison.objective: Install a rack bracket, versus buckle a doll into a car seat.
comparison.physical_skill: Rigid structural registration/latching versus routing and engaging restraint tongues and a buckle clip around a body.
comparison.success_condition: Bracket self-support and clearance versus both tongues and clip latched, correctly positioned, without seat movement or head intrusion.
comparison.reason: Shared latching is generic; the restraint-routing ability and outcome are materially different.
